summary: Tested 'Nuestra historia' (memories) feature end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest passing — /api/memories/meta returns the exact 8 curated emotions (ternura/risa/alegria/orgullo/nostalgia/amor/calma/gratitud), POST /pets/{id}/memories enforces title (400) + owner (404) + auth, invalid emotion keys are filtered, emotion_labels enriched correctly; photo upload accepts JPEG and sets photo_url, non-owner 404; PUT/DELETE enforce owner-only; reflect generates real Claude Spanish reflection (~10s), persists, hide/reflect clears to null; list is newest-first and owner-isolated; delete removes and subsequent GET returns 404. Frontend (390x844 mobile, Rocco seeded, token in localStorage before boot): 24/24 flow checks passing — /album shows seeded memory card + 'Añadir recuerdo', /universo shows the universe-invite-recuerdo card and navigates to /album, full 3-step creation (title->date 'No la sé'->feeling + emotion toggles) reaches the 'Guardado para siempre' reveal, offers Petito reflection with Ver/Volver CTAs, /album/:id view shows title/feeling, memory-ask-reflection generates AI reflection labeled '💭 Un pensamiento de Petito' with 'Escrito por IA' disclaimer and working Ocultar button, edit (title update persists), delete via confirm modal navigates back to /album; regression on /universo /bienvenida /retrato /hablar all load fine.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1505 lines — split into routers (pets, memories, portraits, stories, talk) is overdue per the >700-line guideline.

MemoryView.saveEdit sends happened_on as empty string when eUnknown is true; backend coerces '' -> None in update_memory (line 501 uses .strip() or None), which is correct, but front could just omit the field. Minor only.

Reflect endpoint falls back to a hardcoded Spanish string on any Claude exception (except INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS). This still writes an ai_reflection to the DB; consider surfacing a toast for real failures instead of silently persisting fallback text.

seed_data_creation: Test memories prefixed TEST_pytest_paseo, TEST_updated, TEST_toDelete* created+cleaned by pytest. UI test created TEST_UI_recuerdo_playa / TEST_UI_editado and deleted it via UI; one may remain if any step fails midway (none did).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported (frontend/.env is NOT auto-loaded for backend tests). Run: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... && pytest backend/tests/test_memories_flow.py -o addopts='' -v` to disable xdist loadscope that breaks the module-scoped created_memory_id fixture. Reflect test waits up to 60s. Frontend auth needs addInitScript BEFORE goto since AuthProvider reads localStorage once on mount; RequireAuth renders <Login/> inline (URL doesn't change).
